name: Dastard’s Smoke Pellets
body:
Price 250 gp; Slot none; CL 3rd; Weight –; Aura faint enchantment

DESCRIPTION

These small black pellets contain a special smoke that allows their user to blend into the shadows. A character can throw a smoke pellet to the ground as a swift action to flood a 20 ft radius with smoke, causing all creatures inside of it to make a DC 14 Will save or lose their memory of the last minute. If a creature possesses the dual identity class feature or a class feature that alters it, they can attune a dastard’s smoke pellet to themselves over 24 hours, increasing the DC to 10 + 1/2 their character level + their Charisma modifier. A creature can only attune one dastard’s smoke pellet in this fashion at a time.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 125 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, mindwipe
